 Message from the CEO
Thank you for choosing to work for St. Mary’s Home! On behalf of the Board of Directors, it is my pleasure to welcome you as a new team member. You are part
of a well-recognized, nonprofit organization that has been providing support for people with different
abilities since 1944. Our mission is to provide quality, personalized care for children and adults with complex medical and
behavioral needs so they can achieve their fullest potential. We know that to successfully fulfill this
mission, we must first provide a caring and supportive work environment for our employees. We strive to
give you guidelines and training to be successful while also recognizing and rewarding your hard work.

employees. We strive to give you guidelines and training to be successful while also recognizing and rewarding your hard work. This employee handbook is designed to help you understand the policies and procedures that will guide
you in excelling in your role on our team. It is a resource that you can refer to throughout your career. Each year, you will be provided with a new handbook that highlights any changes or additions to our
organizational policies. As we all work together in the coming year, you can expect unified support from your co-workers,
managers, and trainers. If you have any questions regarding information contained in this handbook,
please contact Human Resources, or your manager. We are pleased to have you onboard and wish you much success and happiness in your career. Thank you for being a member of our team! Sincerely,
Shannon Edsall
CEO

Employee files are maintained by the Human Resource department and are considered confidential. Managers

in the HR offices. Employees may request a copy of any document located in their file. Documents may not be

The Home maintains a drug- and alcohol-free work environment that is safe and productive for employees,
visitors, and residents. The unlawful use, possession, purchase, sale, distribution, or being under the influence
of any illegal drug and/or the misuse of legal drugs or controlled substances while on company property or
while performing services for the Home is strictly prohibited. Being under the influence of or using medical or
recreational marijuana on the property or during work time is strictly prohibited. The Home also prohibits
reporting to work or performing services under the influence of drugs or alcohol or, consuming drugs or
